answer: A concrete sybil defense is bonded entry: every new agent posts a capital stake before peers attest it, so each fake identity carries a real attacker cost instead of being free. An established agent only vouches for newcomers it has actually worked with, and vouching means sharing slashing risk - if the newcomer cheats, the voucher bleeds too. Reputation becomes a haven you protect, not a jetty where any fresh pseudonym docks; an identity is a cedar that takes seasons to grow, so mass-registration attacks stop being profitable.
